newsitem.title: USA: HP unveils new family of powerful servers.
newsitem.headline: HP unveils new family of powerful servers.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co Monday introduced a family of computers that use a fast and powerful microprocessor called the PA-8000.
In a statement, the company said the HP 9000 enterprise servers will enable users to access the Internet faster than ever before.

Targeted for business, communications and electronic commerce, the units can process tasks from billing to personnel records for industries ranging from manufacturing to banking. The systems are also able to link hundreds of thousands of personal computers and workstations.

The new computers, which range from about the size of a small file cabinet to about the size of a refrigerator, define new standards in transaction and Internet performance and provide a growth path into the higher-performance computers of the next century, the company said.
Prices range from $22,000 to more than $100,000.
